items.title: Chubby Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: Igor Stravinsky came up to the Paramount Theater backstage, to rehearse the Ebony Concerto... We played Carnegie Hall with Walter Hendl playing, and that was such a victory for all of us.

ctx.x: Well it’s very difficult. Because it’s really nuts. I mean the guy took a picture and I’ve always been this. I did a dumb thing. Igor Stravinsky came up to the Paramount Theater backstage, to rehearse the Ebony Concerto, and this is wild, it really is—
First sentence: “I have to admit that musicians are strange people and so are their credit ratings.
